findings.title: Supported queries can fail unnoticed
findings.description: Both guideline strings say an error where SQLite returns a value is allowed without limiting that exception to inputs the engine does not support. On a later ticket unrelated to an existing feature, a regression that makes a supported query such as `COALESCE(1, 2)` error would be treated as permissible despite the engine’s documented support for that query.

findings.title: Unlinked changes miss ticket checks
findings.description: Both guideline strings require comparison with a linked ticket but give the reviewer no instruction when a pull request has none. A manually opened pull request can reach review without Yantra’s ticket validation, leaving the requested two-way acceptance-criteria check without a source and without a required missing-ticket finding.
